name: graphify-vscode
description: Local knowledge-graph context for AI coding assistants — no API key required, no code leaves your machine.

viewsWelcome.contents:
No graph built yet for this workspace.
[Build Graph](command:graphify.rebuildGraph)
Requires Python 3.10+ on your PATH. No API key needed — graph construction is 100% local.

graphify.autoBuildOnOpen.description: Automatically build the knowledge graph when a Python workspace is opened (local AST parsing only, no API key or network calls required).

graphify.autoUpdateOnSave.description: Automatically refresh the graph (incremental, AST-only) shortly after saving a Python file.

graphify.pythonPath.description: Path to a Python 3.10+ interpreter to use. Leave empty to auto-detect (python3 / python / py -3).

graphify.queryBudget.description: Maximum tokens graphify will include when returning context for a query.

graphify.devPackagePath.description: Advanced: install graphify from a local path instead of PyPI (for extension development against this repo).

walkthroughs.title: Get Started with Graphify
walkthroughs.description: Build a local knowledge graph of your code and use it with Copilot Chat — no API key required.

steps.title: Build your first graph
steps.description:
Build a local knowledge graph of your Python project. No API key, no network calls.
[Rebuild Graph](command:graphify.rebuildGraph)

steps.title: Explore the graph
steps.description:
Browse God Nodes and Communities in the sidebar, and jump straight to definitions.
[Open Graphify Sidebar](command:workbench.view.extension.graphify)

steps.title: See the whole graph
steps.description:
Open an interactive visualization of your codebase.
[Open Graph Visualization](command:graphify.openGraphView)

steps.title: Ask questions about your code
steps.description:
Query the graph in plain language, or explain the symbol under your cursor.
[Query Codebase](command:graphify.query)

steps.title: Use it with GitHub Copilot Chat
steps.description: Once built, Copilot Chat's agent mode can call Graphify automatically using your own subscription.

languageModelTools.name: graphify_query
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Search the local repository knowledge graph for code, functions, and classes relevant to a natural-language question. Returns a compact, targeted set of relevant nodes and their relationships (calls, imports, inheritance) instead of full file contents — use this before reading whole files to save tokens.

question.description: A natural-language question about the codebase, e.g. 'how does authentication work'

languageModelTools.name: graphify_explain
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get a plain-language explanation of a specific function, class, or file in the repository and its direct neighbors in the knowledge graph (what calls it, what it calls, what it imports).

symbol.description: The exact name of a function, class, or file to explain, e.g. 'validate_url' or 'build.py'

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
